This draft adds a whole-string neural score proposal reader behind Charlie's existing HUD, temporal acceptance and evidence interfaces. The fixed reader remains the default. The crop/CTC corrections make the saved-image pipeline inspectable, protect exact human-visible labels and prevent mismatched preprocessing or silently incorrect ONNX export contracts.

## Resulting behavior

- Original photographs are rectified into a 640×96 HUD, then cropped into separate P1/P2 score channels before CNN preparation. Training-only diagnostics save source/HUD ROI overlays, frozen crops, exact input tensors, hashes, fixed ROI hypotheses and all 64 CTC timestep paths/probabilities/margins. Raw string accuracy, accepted accuracy/coverage, confusions, edit distance and descriptive confidence bins are reported separately.
- Explicit human `00` survives annotation, effective-review resolution, frozen corpus, repeated CTC targets and evaluation. Unsupported `0000` is rejected/excluded; historical annotations remain immutable and corrections retain supersession links. Ambiguous historic numeric zero, conflicting/unreadable labels, bad image hashes, calibration mismatches and synthetic leakage remain guarded.
- Near-duplicate checks include supplied prior frozen manifests. Existing session/source/pixel partition ownership and sealed final-test controls remain enforced.
- Legacy preprocessing and zero boundary-loss weight remain defaults. Fixed padding and optional blank-boundary training supervision are explicit experiments with recorded identity, reproducible seeds and resume mismatch checks. Decoder edge checks and .85 confidence/.25 margin gates are unchanged.
- ONNX export explicitly selects the legacy exporter, verifies actual opset 11, static Conv/Relu graph shape and ORT equivalence. Model metadata binds preprocessing/dataset identity across CPU replay and HEF calibration. Existing weights can be re-exported into a new directory with new integrity records.
- CPU/reference, required/preferred Hailo selection, verified NHWC input/FCR output conversion, HEF/ONNX integrity and shared resource admission remain preserved. Required Hailo never silently becomes CPU. Original review, sampler, original-frame recovery, temporal score, Forebrain/Hindbrain and Learning Executive systems remain in place.

## Evidence and limits

The published historical contact sheet uses two hash-verified repository originals. It shows large margins/bezel/border and strong input stretching; widening one example admits an adjacent life icon. These photographs are not the private 64-image training corpus, and no replacement ROI was activated.

The operator reports corpus-training-005 digest `7a91c73d9ce47d8616abf07a5fbf03727398774972ab8e5fc9d2d9fbc437276f` and model-002 ONNX `e3b44a0894429a148e4fccf51301f4c6179eed00ba33309e2f865b0ff3002686`: 39/64 raw training matches, 0/64 accepted, versus always-00 at 37/64. Actual corpus/checkpoint/ONNX/logits are still private on Mint and were not inspected by Work. The existing 100 reviews do not need repeating; the report provides a training-only artifact bundle command and direct diagnostic/re-export/training commands.

A bounded synthetic control (same 8 images, seed 17, 300 steps each) had 8/8 nonblank edges with legacy and padding-only models, versus 0/8 with boundary supervision. Raw exact and acceptance remained 0/8 for all final variants. This demonstrates an alignment experiment, not recognition improvement. It is prominently synthetic and not authentic/native qualification. Private model-002 crop correctness, missing trailing-digit causes, actual opset and any independent validation benefit remain unestablished.

Operator-reported earlier synthetic HEF compilation, physical Hailo-8L/Python inference and five-image parity remain separate engineering evidence. No new authentic HEF, native model-002 qualification, calibrated confidence, extended native reliability, camera latency, concurrency qualification or gameplay benefit is claimed.
